name: Unabara Hotaru
source:
A beautiful maid with a sad face. She was on the verge of marrying her fiancé, but he was arrested on suspicion of embezzlement, leaving her at a loss. Then, the Tenkuin family offered her the job of becoming a pregnant maid in exchange for settling the situation. For the sake of her future with her fiancé, she reluctantly accepted and became a pregnant maid. After fulfilling her role, she hopes to forget everything and be united with her fiancé, but...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/harameido/]official site[/url]]
